risks.risk_assessment_framework: Risk management process which considers strategic and operational risks. All identified risks are modelled according to their probability of occurrence and potential impact and subsequently prioritised by Group management. A consolidated risk report is reviewed annually by the Audit Committee and the Board of Directors.

identified_risks.description: Risks related to accuracy of financial statements
identified_risks.mitigation: Group's internal control system framework defines relevant control measures which are implemented across the Group and appropriately monitored

identified_risks.description: ESG Risk and Opportunities (ESG ROA) assessment conducted in 2024 to identify, prioritise and contextualise ESG-related risks and opportunities, including on climate, emissions and energy
identified_risks.rationale: At the date of this report, the impact on the financial statements resulting from climate-related risks is not significant. Cash flow forecasts used for impairment testing take into account any known impacts arising from climate-related risks.

identified_risks.description: With effect from 1 June 2022, Türkiye is considered to be hyperinflationary
identified_risks.rationale: There is no significant impact on the consolidated financial statements of the Group as a result.

identified_risks.description: Risk related to recoverable amount of CGUs for goodwill and intangible asset testing
identified_risks.rationale: Goodwill is tested annually for impairment. Critical estimates and assumptions relate to sales growth, EBITDA margins, future cash flows, discount rates and terminal growth rates.

identified_risks.description: Uncertain tax positions and transactions in multiple jurisdictions
identified_risks.rationale: Management exercises judgment in determining the adequate current income tax provision. The Group believes that its accruals for tax liabilities are adequate for all open tax years based on its assessment of many factors, including interpretations of tax law and prior experience.

identified_risks.description: OECD Pillar Two Model rules effective for the Group's financial year beginning 1 April 2024
identified_risks.rationale: Based on legislation enacted to date, the impact on the Group is not expected to be material. The Group has performed an assessment of potential exposure to Pillar Two income taxes.

esg.esg_management: During the year under review, Richemont continued to build and strengthen its ESG Management System. An ESG Risk and Opportunities (ESG ROA) assessment was conducted in 2024 with the aim to identify, prioritise and contextualise ESG-related risks and opportunities, including on climate, emissions and energy. Prioritised risks and opportunities undergo a detailed analysis to contextualise their impact, underlying drivers, current mitigation efforts and potential action plans. This stage leverages both internal and external data sources to enrich understanding and ensure the accuracy and relevance of the assessments. For climate-related risks, the process foresees a scenario analysis, which evaluates potential impacts based on predefined global warming scenarios.
esg.esg_initiatives: The costs associated with specific initiatives undertaken during the year are included with Cost of sales and the various expense line items within Operating Profit, as appropriate.
